recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Build a single-file mobile browser canvas game titled **Rift Hunter K-77**. Preserve the source arcade mechanic loop: the player avatar sits near the bottom of the screen, pointer/touch drag controls horizontal target position only, falling objects descend from the top, collectible collisions add 10 score, hazard collisions trigger immediate game over, and restart resets the run.

Recreate the presentation as a cinematic, irreverent cartoon sci-fi portal hunt centered on an alien hunter. Draw the player as a procedural bug-eyed alien hunter on a small portal sled. Draw collectibles as green/yellow bounty signatures and hazards as pink parasites. Use a toxic green portal corridor background with animated rings, planets, scan lanes, stars, cinematic letterbox bars, comic-style HUD panels, and short hunt-log copy. Keep all art browser-native through Canvas/CSS/HTML, with approved catalog fonts and non-blocking audio/GIF accents.

The game should be visibly transformed beyond labels and color: focal identity, object silhouettes, background ownership, HUD language, failure fantasy, reward fantasy, and feedback must all belong to the same alien-hunter portal world while the avoid/collect mechanics remain unchanged.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first canvas arcade avoid-and-collect survival runner
- objective: steer a bottom-positioned avatar horizontally to collect beneficial falling objects while avoiding hostile falling objects
- input model: pointer/touch/mouse drag or tap updates a horizontally clamped target X; no vertical movement, no keyboard requirement
- core loop: initialize canvas, auto-enter play, spawn falling objects, move player toward target, detect circular collisions, add score for collectibles, game over on hazards, restart to reset
- fail/friction state: collision with an avoid object triggers immediate game-over overlay; escalating spawn/speed pressure increases avoidance difficulty over distance

## Protected mechanics
- Horizontal steering only through pointer/touch/mouse target X.
- Player remains near 80% screen height and lerps toward target.
- Falling entities spawn from the top and descend with distance-scaled speed.
- Collectible collision adds exactly 10 points.
- Hazard collision immediately changes state to game over.
- Restart resets score, distance, objects, particles, and play state.
- Distance-based story beats and pressure escalation remain intact.

## Remixed target
Rift Hunter K-77 is a cinematic cartoon sci-fi portal bounty sweep inspired by irreverent multiverse animation. The player is a bug-eyed alien hunter riding a scanner sled through a toxic green rift corridor, capturing escaped portal signatures and dodging pink parasite hazards. The new public surface replaces old signal-relay identity with authored procedural scene ownership, comic HUD panels, cinematic letterbox framing, portal atmospherics, and alien-hunter silhouettes while preserving the source avoid/collect loop exactly.
